name: CONCAT
description: CONCAT joins two or more text strings into one string.
tldr: CONCAT combines multiple text strings into a single string.

parameters.name: text1
parameters.description: The first text string to concatenate.

parameters.name: text2
parameters.description: Optional additional text strings to concatenate.

advancedExamples.title: Create email from name
advancedExamples.description: Combine first and last name to create an email address
advancedExamples.explanation: Creates a standardized email from first and last name.

advancedExamples.title: Concatenate with array
advancedExamples.description: Combine values from a range into one string
advancedExamples.explanation: In Excel 365, CONCAT automatically handles arrays.

howItWorks: CONCAT joins text strings in the order they are provided, without any separator. For adding separators, use TEXTJOIN instead.

howToSteps.name: Select output cell
howToSteps.text: Choose where the result should appear.

howToSteps.name: Press Enter
howToSteps.text: The result shows the combined text.

limitations: For older Excel versions, use CONCATENATE or the & operator.

commonErrors.cause: Function not supported in Excel version

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: CONCAT works identically in Google Sheets.

faq.question: What is the difference between CONCAT and CONCATENATE?
faq.answer: CONCAT is newer and supports ranges, while CONCATENATE only supports individual arguments.

faq.question: Can I use CONCAT with numbers?
faq.answer: Yes, numbers are automatically converted to text.
